name: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia
short_description: A half marathon with 10 km, 5 km and a 500 m kids' dash, run on 20 September 2026 at ICE BSD, Tangerang, Indonesia, and organised by Garmin Indonesia.
ai_summary: Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia, held in 2026 as the Garmin Run Marathon Series, was run on Sunday 20 September 2026 from the Hall 10 parking area of the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Tangerang. Garmin Indonesia organised it with D&Dsport as race management. It offered a half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km and a 500 m RMHC Kids Dash.

core_facts.venue: Hall 10 parking area, Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE), BSD City

pros: Seven water stations with medical posts on the half-marathon course
Early 4.45am half-marathon start, before the heat builds
Strollers allowed in every race, plus a 500 m kids' dash
cons: Humid at the start: 26°C with a 23°C dew point in 2026
Race packs must be collected in Jakarta, not at the BSD venue
No refunds, transfers or distance changes
Podium places and prizes are for Indonesian citizens only

excerpt_quotes.quote: Garmin Run Indonesia membuat kami merasa diterima sepenuhnya. Sejak pertama kali ikut dua tahun lalu, saya merasa event ini tidak hanya tentang lari, tetapi juga tentang kebersamaan.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Ricendy, #PelariIsyarat and Garmin Run Club member, quoted in Garmin Indonesia press release

research_highlights: Course starts and finishes at the Hall 10 parking area of ICE BSD (Indonesia Convention Exhibition), Tangerang, with categories of 5K, 10K, Half Marathon (21K) and a Kids Dash.
The course is described by local tech media as relatively flat in the BSD area, which is why runners often use it to chase a personal best time.
The event has grown year on year: the 2025 edition drew over 7,000 participants, and Garmin reported 8,000 runners in 2026, the most since the first edition in 2022.

The race has strong inclusivity features reported by participants and organizers, including sign-language interpreters, large visual countdown screens, and wheelchair-accessible routes for disabled runners.
For 2026 the event ran as the 'Garmin Run Marathon Series', with the same 5K/10K/21K/Kids Dash format.
research_watchouts: Race-day crowds are large — one report described the start area as turning into a 'sea of people' ('lautan manusia') with thousands massing before dawn, so expect crowded starting corrals.

Most available English/Indonesian coverage found is organizer press material or sponsored event recaps rather than independent runner reviews, so course-condition details (heat, water stations, crowding on route) are not well documented by third parties.

faqs.question: When was the Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia?
faqs.answer: The Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 – Indonesia was run on Sunday 20 September 2026 at ICE BSD in Tangerang. The half marathon started at 4.45am, the 10 km at 5.20am, the 5 km at 5.35am and the 500 m kids' dash at 7am, according to the official rules.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: The 2026 race offered a half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km and a 500 m RMHC Kids Dash for children aged 5 to 12. The organiser measured the courses with Garmin at 21.12 km, 10.14 km and 5.04 km. There was no full marathon.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race started and finished at the Hall 10 parking area of the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Tangerang, according to the official rules; ICE's own listing gave Outdoor Plaza B-C. Race packs were collected in Jakarta, at Epiwalk Mall in Rasuna Epicentrum, on 18 and 19 September.
